summary: Transforms each of four wheel-contact corner vectors by a 3x3 rotation matrix stored on the object, adds the world-origin offset, queries the collision normal from feature data, stores it into the per-corner contact-normal pointer array, and updates wheel-surface friction for the contact. Runs once per frame tick as part of the wheel contact/collision system.

operations.description: Iterate over the four wheel contacts: the corner-vector base advances by 74 floats and the contact-normal pointer array by 62 pointer slots each step, until the corner index reaches 296 floats.
Rotate the per-corner offset vector (this[523..525]) by the 3x3 rotation matrix stored at fields 0x704 through 0x724 to produce the local-space contact vector components.
Add the world-origin offset vector this[443] to the transformed contact point via F_3DVectorAddition.
Pack the transformed contact coordinates and the constant dword payload (v12..v15, preserved verbatim) into the query structure passed to the collision query.
Query the collision normal for the contact point from the feature-data global dbl_7C9360 via CollisionNormalFromFeature, writing the resulting vector into the out parameter.
When a valid collision normal is returned, apply the 0.050000001 contact-depth adjustment and store the normal into the corner's contact-normal pointer slot (array rooted at field 0x3668).
Update the wheel-surface friction for the contact via WheelSurfaceContactFriction, passing the feature data and the transformed contact point.
